formal_implied_inclusion.name: isImpliedIncluded

bodies.body: Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the ownedRelationships of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any ownedRelationships with isImplied = true, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then ownedRelationships may not contain any implied Relationships. That is, either all required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.

formal_implied_inclusion.xml:
<ownedAttribute xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-isImpliedIncluded" ns0:type="uml:Property" name="isImpliedIncluded">
            <defaultValue ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-isImpliedIncluded-defaultValue" ns0:type="uml:LiteralBoolean" name="" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-isImpliedIncluded-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the <code>ownedRelationships</code> of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any <code>ownedRelationships</code> with <code>isImplied = true</code>, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then <code>ownedRelationships</code> may <em>not</em> contain any implied Relationships. That is, either <em>all</em> required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Elements-Element-isImpliedIncluded" />
</ownedComment>
            <type href="https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20161101/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Boolean" />
          </ownedAttribute>

formal_implied_inclusion.name: validateElementIsImpliedIncluded

bodies.body: If an Element has any ownedRelationships for which isImplied = true, then the Element must also have isImpliedIncluded = true. (Note that an Element can have isImplied = true even if no ownedRelationships have isImplied = true, indicating the Element simply has no implied Relationships.

formal_implied_inclusion.xml:
<ownedRule xmlns:ns0="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20161101" ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-validateElementIsImpliedIncluded" ns0:type="uml:Constraint" name="validateElementIsImpliedIncluded">
            <constrainedElement ns0:idref="Root-Elements-Element" />
            <ownedComment ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-validateElementIsImpliedIncluded-_comment.0" ns0:type="uml:Comment" body="<p>If an <code>Element</code> has any <code>ownedRelationships</code> for which <code>isImplied = true</code>, then the <code>Element</code> must also have <code>isImpliedIncluded = true</code>. (Note that an <code>Element</code> <em>can</em> have <code>isImplied = true</code> even if no <code>ownedRelationships</code> have <code>isImplied = true</code>, indicating the <code>Element</code> simply has no implied <code>Relationships</code>.</p>">
              <annotatedElement ns0:idref="Root-Elements-Element-validateElementIsImpliedIncluded" />
</ownedComment>
            <specification ns0:id="Root-Elements-Element-validateElementIsImpliedIncluded-specification0" ns0:type="uml:OpaqueExpression" body="ownedRelationship->exists(isImplied) implies isImpliedIncluded" language="OCL2.0" name="" />
          </ownedRule>
